results.title: Minimum Password Length
results.rationale: Short passwords (e.g., 4 characters) are trivially brute-forced offline and online.
results.recommendation: Increase minimum password length from 4 to 12+ characters via `pwpolicy -setaccountpolicies` or an MDM Passcode payload.

results.title: Character Diversity / Complexity Rule
results.required_value: Must enforce >= 3 of 4 classes (upper, lower, digit, symbol) or >= 15-char passphrase
results.rationale: Prevents single-class numeric PINs or dictionary words from being accepted.
results.recommendation: Add character-class rules (uppercase, lowercase, digit, special character) or enforce >= 15-character passphrases in `policyCategoryPasswordContent`.

results.title: Password History Enforcement
results.rationale: Stops users from cycling back to previously compromised passwords.

results.title: Failed Login Attempt Lockout
results.rationale: Mitigates online credential-stuffing and interactive password guessing.

results.title: Maximum Password Age / Expiration Policy
results.required_value: Defined expiration policy (<= 365 days or risk-based breach check)
results.rationale: Ensures periodic credential rotation or explicit risk-based expiration governance.
results.recommendation: Define `policyAttributeExpiresEveryNDays` <= 365 days (or document an explicit NIST 800-63B exception paired with compromised-password screening).

results.title: Domain / MDM Password Policy Management
results.required_value: Managed via Active Directory or MDM profile
results.actual_value: Standalone local host (AD: No, DEP: No, MDM: No)
results.rationale: Centralized enforcement ensures uniform compliance across all endpoints.
results.recommendation: Enroll workstation into enterprise MDM (e.g., Jamf/Kandji/Intune) and push a `com.apple.mobiledevice.passwordpolicy` configuration profile.

results.title: Automatic Login Disabled
results.rationale: Prevents unauthorized physical access upon device reboot.

results.title: Guest Account Disabled
results.rationale: Eliminates unauthenticated local guest sessions.

results.title: Screen Lock Timeout
results.rationale: Limits exposure window when a workstation is left unattended.
results.recommendation: Meets baseline (<= 300s). Optionally tighten to 60–120s for high-sensitivity roles.

results.title: Password Hashing Algorithm
results.rationale: Slow salted key derivation resists offline cracking.

results.title: Full Disk Encryption (FileVault)
results.rationale: Protects local credential databases and user data at rest.

results.title: Directory-Backed PAM Authentication
results.required_value: pam_opendirectory.so enforced on passwd, sudo, authorization
results.actual_value: pam_opendirectory.so active in passwd, sudo, authorization
results.rationale: Ensures CLI tools and privilege escalation honor system password policies.
